::: {#exm-fitted-residual-error}
#### Fitted values, residuals, and prediction errors for three points

Take the points $(0, 1)$, $(1, 2)$, $(2, 2)$
and the line with $\intcoef = 1$ and $\coef{x} = 0.5$
from [the residual sum of squares example](correlation-regression.qmd#exm-rss),
and treat the line as the fitted model.

| $x_i$ | $y_i$ | $\fitted_i = 1 + 0.5 x_i$ | $\resid_i = y_i - \fitted_i$ | $\prederr_i = \fitted_i - y_i$ |
|:-----:|:-----:|:-----:|:-----:|:-----:|
| 0 | 1 | 1   | 0   | 0    |
| 1 | 2 | 1.5 | 0.5 | $-0.5$ |
| 2 | 2 | 2   | 0   | 0    |

The mean squared error of these predictions is

$$
\mselr{\fitted}
= \frac{0^2 + (-0.5)^2 + 0^2}{3}
= \frac{0.25}{3}
\approx 0.083,
$$

the residual sum of squares, $0.25$, divided by $n = 3$.
:::
